source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,071 records)

talents.name: Improved Wrath
ranks: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.1 sec and its Mana cost by 50%.

talents.name: Nature's Grasp
ranks: The next 1 melee attack that strikes the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 1). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.

talents.name: Overgrowth
ranks: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.

talents.name: Improved Entangling Roots
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 75%, and its victims can take up to 75% more damage without interrupting the effect.

talents.name: Improved Moonfire
ranks: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 2%.

talents.name: Natural Weapons
ranks: Increases the damage you deal with physical attacks in all forms by 2%.
Increases the damage you deal with physical attacks in all forms by 4%.
Increases the damage you deal with physical attacks in all forms by 6%.
Increases the damage you deal with physical attacks in all forms by 8%.
Increases the damage you deal with physical attacks in all forms by 10%.

talents.name: Natural Shapeshifter
ranks: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Thorns
ranks: Increases damage caused by your Thorns spell by 25%.
Increases damage caused by your Thorns spell by 50%.
Increases damage caused by your Thorns spell by 75%.

talents.name: Omen of Clarity
ranks: Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources.

talents.name: Nature's Reach
ranks: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

talents.name: Vengeance
ranks: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Starfire
ranks: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.5 sec and Starfire has a 15% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Nature's Grace
ranks: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

talents.name: Moonglow
ranks: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

talents.name: Moonfury
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 2%.

talents.name: Moonkin Form
ranks: Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

talents.name: Ferocity
ranks: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 1 Rage or Energy.

talents.name: Feral Aggression
ranks: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Demoralizing Roar by 8% and the damage caused by your Ferocious Bite by 3%.
Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Demoralizing Roar by 16% and the damage caused by your Ferocious Bite by 6%.
Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Demoralizing Roar by 24% and the damage caused by your Ferocious Bite by 9%.
Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Demoralizing Roar by 32% and the damage caused by your Ferocious Bite by 12%.
Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Demoralizing Roar by 40% and the damage caused by your Ferocious Bite by 15%.

talents.name: Feral Instinct
ranks: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 3% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 0.6 levels higher.

talents.name: Brutal Impact
ranks: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 0.5 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

talents.name: Thick Hide
ranks: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3 additional base Armor per level and another 1 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

talents.name: Feral Swiftness
ranks: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

talents.name: Feral Charge (Bear)
ranks: Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.

talents.name: Sharpened Claws
ranks: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 2%.

talents.name: Shredding Attacks
ranks: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 6 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 6.
Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 12.

talents.name: Predatory Strikes
ranks: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 50% of your level.

talents.name: Blood Frenzy
ranks: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 0% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Savage Fury
ranks: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Heart of the Wild
ranks: Increases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Leader of the Pack
ranks: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within 45 yards by 3%.

talents.name: Improved Mark of the Wild
ranks: Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 7%.
Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 14%.
Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 21%.
Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 28%.
Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 35%.

talents.name: Furor
ranks: Gives you a 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 20% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 2 Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to 20 Energy.

talents.name: Naturalist
ranks: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch and Wild Growth spells by 0.1 sec and increases all damage you deal by 100%.

talents.name: Nature's Focus
ranks: Gives your Arcane and Nature spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Improved Enrage
ranks: The Enrage ability now instantly generates 5 Rage.
The Enrage ability now instantly generates 10 Rage.

talents.name: Reflection
ranks: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Insect Swarm
ranks: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Subtlety
ranks: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Tranquil Spirit
ranks: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch and Tranquility spells by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Rejuvenation
ranks: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 5%.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
ranks: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Gift of Nature
ranks: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Tranquility
ranks: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%.

talents.name: Improved Regrowth
ranks: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 10%.

talents.name: Swiftmend
ranks: Instantly heals a target with your active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of the consumed spell.
